feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 5:31am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

West or NW 2 to 4, backing South or SW 3 or 4 during this morning or early afternoon, then veering and increasing West 4 or 5 in the evening. Little change tonight.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate this evening.


##Weather)##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the west later this morning and afternoon, clearing later in evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 11°C
##Sea Temperature##

10°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

West 4 or 5, backing SW tomorrow morning, decreasing 3 or 4 in the evening.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then occasional showers for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

10°C
##Monday, 18 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

SW 3 or 4, backing South, gradually increasing 5 or 6 later in day/ overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair , then rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

10°C
##Tuesday, 19 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

South veering SW 5 or 6.


##State of sea)##

Moderate.


##Weather)##

Rain, then clearing to isolated showers. Patchy rain later in night.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor in rain, then becoming mostly good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

11°C
##Wednesday, 20 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

SW 5 or 6, backing South 4 or 5.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Patchy rain clearing, then mostly fair but a risk of mist/ fog patches.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good, but falling poor/ very poor in any mist/ fog.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

11°C
